title: SlotTrack
tagline: A race-condition-safe fitness class booking platform.
shortDescription: Fitness-class booking platform designed around real-time seat availability and concurrency-safe reservations.
description: Fitness-class booking platform designed around real-time seat availability and concurrency-safe reservations.

caseStudy.problem: A booking system must keep seat inventory correct when multiple users reserve the same class simultaneously.
caseStudy.solution: Combine application validation with database transactions and row locking (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) so availability is updated atomically.
features: Class discovery with location and search filtering
caseStudy.challenges: Concurrency; consistent seat counts; duplicate reservations; separation of business logic and persistence.
caseStudy.outcome: Structured booking system centered around reservation consistency.
